address: Khasra No./ Plot No.A-5 , AIRPORT ENCLAVE SCHEME, TONK ROAD, DURGAPURA , Jaipur - 302018 (Rajasthan)
remark:
Since the property situated at Plot No. A-5, Airport Enclave Scheme, Tonk Road, Durgapura, Jaipur, on which the promoter is planning to develop and construct the project "Insignia", was auctioned in favour of the promoter by Jaipur Development Authority and as per Point 11 of Auction Terms & Conditions of the said property (Copy attached under head "Project Approval Document" of "Documents Tab"), the promoter is not required to get the maps approved before starting the construction on the said property and is required to submit an Affidavit in this regard to the concerned authorities (Copy of Affidavit also attached under head Project Approval Document" of "Documents Tab"). The Promoter has complied with the conditions mentioned in the Point 11 of Auction Terms & Conditions of the said property and the related documents have been duly uploaded in the RERA Application under the tab "Documents". Also, even though the promoter is not required to get the maps approved as per point 11 of Auction Terms & Conditions, the promoter has applied for the maps approval, copy of which is also attached under head "Project Approval Document" of "Documents Tab".
Further, as per Pt. No. 5 of Circular No. क्रमांक प.18(25) नविवि/सामान्य/2014 dated 27.06.2017 and  Pt. No. 2 of Circular No. क्रमांक प.10(7) नविवि/3/2009 पार्ट-III dated 22.06.2017 issued by Urban Development & Housing Department (Copy of the same attached under head "Project Approval Document" of "Documents Tab") regarding Fire NOC & EC respectively, at the construction stage, instead of submitting Fire NOC and EC, the promoter is only required to submit an Affidavit in this regard (Copy of the same attached under head "Project Approval Document" of "Documents Tab"). However, the promoter has applied for EC, the application of which is also attached under “Documents” tab. The promoter has also received Airport NOC &applied for revised Airport NOC, both of which are attached under head "Project Approval Document".

costDetail.n: For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub-section (2) of section 4, the land cost shall be the cost incurred by the promoter whether as an outright purchase, lease charges etc.
Revenue or area share given to land owner in lieu of land under any kind of agreement such as Joint Venture, Joint Development etc, in case the Promoter is not the owner of the land.
Amount paid to land owner. (Method of land valuation)
Incidental costs related to acquisition of land such as stamp duty, brokerage, settlement costs of litigation, premiums paid to government authorities related to land.
Interest on finance for purchase of land.
Litigation costs incurred for land acquisition.
Property and other taxes, fees, premiums paid.
Estimated Cost of Construction as certified by Engineer

For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub - section (2) of section 4, the construction cost shall be the total cost incurred by the promoter, towards the on - site expenditure for the physical development of the project and includes fees payable to the architects, consultants, project managers / staff including engineers, marketing agents etc. fees / charges / security deposit payable to various departments / authorities, Labor Cess, VAT which are incurred during the development of the project.

On-site expenditure for development of entire project excluding cost of construction as per (ii) above, i.e. 
salaries, consultants fees, site overheads, cost of services (including water, electricity, sewerage), cost of 
machineries and equipment including its hire and maintenance costs, consumables etc. All costs directly 
incurred to complete the construction of the buildings /wings of the project registered
Payment of Taxes, cess, fees, charges, Approval cost for Construction etc. premiums, interest etc. to any statutory Authority
Interest payable to financial institutions, scheduled banks, non-banking financial institution (NBFC) or money lenders on construction funding or money borrowed for construction & Project
